final: WITH eligible AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'), per_patient AS (SELECT e.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff FROM eligible e JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = e.ID GROUP BY e.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_of_patient_pt_averages, AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS avg_of_patient_tat_diff_averages FROM per_patient
